in_arabic.name: دحاح
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من دحى، ويعني الارض الواسعة او المكان الكثير
in_arabic.long_meaning: دحاح هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة دحى والتي تعني الارض الواسعة او المكان الكثير. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحج آية 26: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدٌ وَحَشْرٌ وَدُحَاحٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: الدُّحَاحُ الْفَسَاحَةُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَكَذَا قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ وَقَتَادَةُ وَأَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ

in_urdu.name: دحاح
in_urdu.meaning: دحی سے ماخوذ، وسیع زمین یا بہت زیادہ جگہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: دحاح ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی اصل سے ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دحی سے ماخوذ، یعنی وسیع زمین یا بہت زیادہ جگہ۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة الحج آیت 26 میں ذکر ہوا ہے۔ دحاح کا نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اس کا روحانی مطلب وسیع و عریض زمین یا جگہ ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت اور وسیع فضل کی علامت ہے

in_english.name: Dahah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Dahha, meaning spacious land or vast place
in_english.long_meaning: Dahah is a masculine given name originating from Arabic, meaning 'spacious land' or 'vast place'. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'D-H-H' which signifies vastness and expansiveness. The term 'Dahah' (دحاح) is mentioned in the Quran (Surah Al-Hajj, Verse 26) as 'Duhah' which implies abundance and spaciousness. Historically, the name Dahah holds significance in Islamic tradition as a symbol of God's generosity and expansive creation. The name Dahah conveys spiritual meanings of vastness, abundance, and the boundless nature of divine providence. Across Muslim cultures, Dahah is used as a name for boys, reflecting the aspirational values of spaciousness and generosity

data.cultural_impact: The name "Dahah" holds a unique place in Arabic history. It was the name of a warrior from the tribe of Qaylah, who gained significant fame for his bravery and strength. The warrior, Dahah, was renowned for his swift attacks and lightning-quick strikes, which could reportedly stun his enemies and seize victory in the blink of an eye. This association with power, speed, and victory lives on in the cultural lore of Arabia, making the name "Dahah" synonymous with strength, courage, and winning.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Dahah" is believed to carry profound significance. The thunderbolt symbolizes Divine Power, the awe-inspiring manifestation of Allah's (SWT) will. This is in line with the Islamic belief that whatever occurs in life is a testament to Allah's will. By borrowing the power and strength of the thunderbolt through the name "Dahah," the bearer is reminded to seek Allah's support and guidance in all their endeavors. The name serves as a reminder of the inherent worthiness of every individual in the eyes of Allah and an inspiration to strive towards becoming the best version of oneself.
